name: MTS Social Auto Post
author: Monir Tech Solutions

sections.description:
MTS Social Auto Post automatically shares your WordPress posts to your Facebook Page when published. Save time and grow your social media presence.

Current Version: Facebook Pages Only
This plugin currently supports Facebook Pages. Support for additional social media platforms including Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Instagram is planned for future releases.

Features

  • Auto-post when posts are published
  • Manual share button on each post
  • Customizable message templates with variables
  • Featured image support
  • Category filtering
  • Post type support (posts, pages, custom)
  • Scheduled delay posting
  • Complete post log with status
  • Automatic retry for failed posts
  • Bulk re-share old posts
  • URL shortening (WordPress, TinyURL)
  • Dashboard widget with stats
  • Encrypted credential storage
  • Per-post message override

Template Variables

  • {title} – Post title
  • {excerpt} – Post excerpt
  • {url} – Post URL
  • {author} – Author name
  • {date} – Publish date
  • {categories} – Post categories
  • {tags} – Post tags
  • {site_name} – Your site name

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A Facebook Page you manage
  • A Facebook App (free to create)

Third Party Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality:

Facebook Graph API

  • Purpose: Publishing posts to your Facebook Page
  • Data sent: Post content, URLs, featured images
  • Privacy Policy: Facebook Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service: Facebook Terms of Service

TinyURL (Optional)

  • Purpose: URL shortening when enabled in settings
  • Data sent: Post URLs for shortening
  • Privacy Policy: TinyURL Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service: TinyURL Terms of Service

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms of service and privacy policies of these third-party services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload mts-social-auto-post folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Social Auto Post then Settings
  4. Create a Facebook App at developers.facebook.com
  5. Enter your App ID, App Secret, Page ID, and Access Token
  6. Configure your posting preferences
  7. Start auto-posting
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support other social media platforms besides Facebook?

Currently, MTS Social Auto Post supports Facebook Pages only. We are actively developing support for additional platforms:

  • Twitter/X (Coming Soon)
  • LinkedIn (Coming Soon)
  • Instagram (Coming Soon)

Subscribe to plugin updates to be notified when new platforms are added!

Do I need a Facebook App?

Yes. Create a free app at developers.facebook.com. This ensures posts appear directly from your page without third-party branding.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, completely free with all features included. No premium version.

What happens if posting fails?

The plugin automatically retries failed posts up to 3 times with exponential backoff. You can also manually retry from the post log.

Can I share old posts?

Yes. Use the Bulk Share feature to select and share multiple existing posts.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Your App Secret and Access Token are encrypted before storage.
